policy: Every dependency with a lifecycle install script is listed with what the script does. A new name fails check:supply-chain until reviewed. Version bumps of listed names are re-read during the dependency update review.

@parcel/watcher.reason: install runs node-gyp rebuild only when npm_config_build_from_source=true; otherwise a no-op and prebuilt optional binaries are used.

@swc/core.reason: postinstall validates the native binding; if none loads it runs npm install --no-save of @swc/wasm at the same version from the configured registry.

fsevents.reason: Native macOS module built at install; skipped on Linux CI and Windows.

msw.reason: postinstall copies the service worker only when package.json declares msw.workerDirectory; this repository declares none, so it is a no-op.

unrs-resolver.reason: postinstall via napi-postinstall verifies the platform binding and may install the matching binding package from the registry as a fallback.
